# tab-bar

## Passthrough

`TabProps` carries the consumer's drag handlers and `data-*` attributes, plus
`ref`, per
[the passthrough contract](../../../primitives/plugins/passthrough/CLAUDE.md).
Each variant spreads them onto the `<Line>` it renders — the tab's one node.

`<Tab>` itself is the dispatcher, not a variant: it renders the selected variant
through the sealed-component isolation middleware, and (see the note in
`web/components/tab.tsx`) does not promise to forward a root ref. A consumer
needing a DOM handle wraps `<Tab>` in its own element.

- Sub-plugins:
  - **`chip`** — Accent-filled pill tab (the canonical chip look).
  - **`connected`** — Folder tab; the active tab merges into the content surface.
  - **`customizer`** — Registers the tab-bar variant picker (chip / underline / connected) into the theme customizer.
  - **`underline`** — Flat tab; the active tab is underlined flush with the bar.
